probe.title: Exemplar — A new typeface by Letters from Sweden
probe.text_sample: Exemplar — A new typeface by Letters from Sweden 2026 Exemplar from Sweden Menu Story Typeface Stone Hands Buy Fonts The End Copyright © 1994–2026 Letters from Sweden Website by Here-Now Exemplar, SET IN STONE VIA CROCIALETTO, Pietrasanta 32 years of work carved in marble A new typeface by Letters from Sweden Exemplar has been drawn and redrawn for thirty years. To mark the final version, we carved its history into three street signs. One for each address and decade – where and when it took shape. Exemplar now spans Latin, Cyrillic, Greek, and Arabic. It is complete. Watch the film (1:28) Monument Эпитафия ARTEMISGATAN, Hjorthagen A quiet street in a Stockholm suburb Holy Stone Παρθενών VIA CROCIALETTO, Pietrasanta Hands shaping letters It doesn’t take three decades to design a typeface. But, nonetheless, Göran began drawing what is now Exemplar, in 1994, on his Power Macintosh 7100. Exemplar comes in 5 weights with italics , supporting 370 languages with its 1018 glyphs .
